pedal: Boss AW-3 Dynamic Wah — blind test: the knobs set by the user, unknown to the analysis (mono: Guitar input -> Output)
comment: The user sets Mode (Up, Down or Sharp), Manual, Sens and Decay anywhere and keeps them there for the four takes; the settings are to be read from the recordings alone. The inputs are October's own: the noise staircase (where the filter rests = Manual, the level at which it starts to move and where it stops = Sens, which way it moves and its shape = Mode) and the noise jump (the return after loud noise = Decay), both with takes at known positions to compare with (2026-10-31-up, 2026-10-31-modes). A very quiet noise shows the rest with the detector nearly idle, and the funk excerpt over the tones is a check of the model at a setting it has never seen.

takes.name: bypass-stairs
takes.note: The pedal off (its LED off): the bypass reference. Guitar input, Output; nothing in EXP/CTL.

takes.name: blind-quiet
takes.note: The pedal on. Mode on Up, Down or Sharp and the three knobs wherever you like: write them down, do not tell. The same setting for all four takes.
